title: Neko Health raises $700 million to expand AI body scans in the US
summary: Neko Health, the preventive health screening startup founded by Spotify co-founder Daniel Ek, has raised $700 million in Series C funding to expand its AI-powered full-body scanning service from Europe to the United States, starting with a clinic in New York.
problem_solved: Making comprehensive preventive health screening more accessible through non-invasive, AI-powered full-body scans that detect diseases early.
why_valuable: This approach to preventive healthcare could revolutionize early disease detection and reduce healthcare costs by identifying health issues before they become serious.
